Jaburo is silent and the Federation reels. Hazuki readies the Dragon...
The Getter Team will join, says Dr. Saotome. The Gandor Team stops at the Saotome Laboratory.
Mazinger Z should be in the robot museum, yet it'll join the Gandor Team. Off to the Photon Power Lab.
The Fortress of Science Lab is under attack. Alerted, the Gandor Team heads there, to Suruga Bay.
With the super robots aboard, Hazuki proposes a stop at Sasebo. What could be waiting there...?
To send forces to Londo Bell in space, the Gandor Team came to the Space Science Lab's HLV site...
Mysterious giant weapons are appearing in war-spared Shinjuku.
Mutron, a mystic power. A strange army nears its lab. The Copelander Team is holding them off...
Off to Iga Village to check a strange energy reading. What will ninja-believing Romina find...?
Tokyo, still scarred by war... Now insect-like weapons appear.
Ex-Argama pilots who fled Jaburo are chased by Zeon ground forces. The team heads to the SOS islet.
As Dr. Nanbara foresaw, a new foe appears. The Nanbara Connection, our supply stop, is in danger...
The Aura Battler seen in Tokyo has now appeared in New York. Who has come up this time...?
From data Kamille intercepted, a likely Zeon secret base is found. The team goes to confirm, but...
A military SOS from the desert... Who sent it? What's out there...?
The Gandor Team heads to Jaburo to check on silent Federation HQ...
Recovering unknown wreckage, Kyosuke's group is engulfed in a blinding light. What lies beyond...?
The Storm Sphere, born every few centuries, holds Sheela Lapana, Na's queen, taken by Drake. Save her...
Drake's army is attacking Na. Elle's Goraon is defending Castle Uroporos and the unfinished Gran Garan, but...
To return to the surface, Drake must fall and the E Ferario Silky Mau be freed. On to Castle Drake.
Failing to retake Jaburo, the Gandor Team returns to base to regroup...
Akira's missing father Ichiro is the Demon Empire's hostage. The team heads for the volcanic isle.
Word comes that the Campbellians are attacking the Nanbara Connection again. The old man's in danger!
Domon trains on in the Guiana Highlands, a place of memories...
To send forces up against the colony drop, the team came to the Space Science Lab for Kirhasium fuel.
The team heads to Kursk to destroy the Nanafushi and find the Nadesico. Was it lost to the Railgun...!?
The Za Boom Army deploys in old Kyoto. Garrison hears they've brought a big machine into town...
Hyakki forces close in on the Saotome Lab, where Getter G is complete. But can it move right away...?
Chasing Garuda, the Combattler Team found the Campbellian base. Can they hold out till we arrive...?
Near the island where Amuro joined us, Federation supply ships keep vanishing... A new enemy!?
Foiled over Getter G, Burai attacks from his fortress isle. Through heavy flak, the Dragon storms the oni lair.
Resupplying in Kawasaki City before re-entering Jaburo, the Gandor Team is hit by the Jovian Lizards...
In eastern Jaburo, Neo Zeon troops close on Federation HQ. Is this Haman Karn's main force!?
Zeon ground forces hold northern Jaburo. What plan have these weakened troops hatched...!?
Titans mobile suits push into west Jaburo. What do war's ghosts want!?
In southern Jaburo, mechs of the fallen Hyakki and Mykene Empires are massing... But why...!?
The Gandor Team reaches the heart of Jaburo and Federation HQ. The Earth Upheaval Arc's finale begins...
To counter the Vega Star Federation, Neo Zeon, and unknown invaders, Londo Bell leaves Luna II.
An unknown ship heads straight for Earth. Londo Bell forms a defense line on its path to stop its descent...
A recon craft vanished behind the moon, likely attacked... If we expose the enemy's plan and strike first...
Vega moves on the colonies. Stop it before it reaches the cluster...
Another unknown force nears Earth. They seem to be fighting...
Leaving the Gandor Team behind, the Nadesico heads for Mars, but the Barrier Satellites block its way...!
An HLV's distress signal. Londo Bell heads to Satsuki Midori 2 Colony to meet the Mazinger Team.
The Gaizok, back from Earth, are spotted in the same area. Zambot 3 may be holding out, but...
A distress signal was picked up near the moon. But it soon vanished... Who sent it...?
Londo Bell detects odd gravity waves and goes to investigate.
The Nadesico arrives on Mars. Just what awaits it there...?
In the colony-packed zone, a Bunker and Gyandlar alliance seems to have started fighting someone...
A distress call from the Cyber Beast Force, who left the HLV... Londo Bell heads to PLS Black Point.
A Tulip floating in space. To confirm reports that it has become active, Londo Bell heads for the area.
A sweep picks up what seems to be an unknown mobile suit at a derelict colony. It isn't Neo Zeon, so what...?
Konpei Island, one of the Federation's few bases. Neo Zeon is massing at this former Solomon...
Nina at Anaheim reports Vega attacking Von Braun! The Ra Cailum and Nadesico set course for the moon.
Unknown units mass in the asteroid field. At a time like this, they're hardly friends, so...
An odd energy reading at PLS Black Point, where we met the Cyber Beast Force. Londo Bell heads there.
Going ahead of Londo Bell to guard the Gate of Zedan from a new power, the Nadesico found...
Excellen, who suddenly flew off, seems to be near the Stone Circle. It's a dangerous place to go alone...
The supposed lunar colony drop was really a loop around the moon to hit Earth! Londo Bell sorties.
Londo Bell comes to Anaheim for the Gundam GP03 Dendrobium. They must chase the colony now, but...
Sent up to stop the colony drop, the Elshank broke down and is stranded near a derelict colony.
Energy at PLS Black Point is rising fast. Even with the colony drop as priority, is it too dangerous to ignore?
Londo Bell came to Luna II to resupply, rushing to chase the colony...
Drawn by something, Raideen left the Elshank and is alone at the Stone Circle. It's on the way...
Catching the colony, Londo Bell fights Neo Zeon to stop Stardust.
Stardust foiled, Londo Bell heads to Nergal's lunar dock to resupply.
Crossbone Vanguard's Carozzo unleashes Bugs, killing machines, to seize the colony. Hurry to Frontier I!
Solomon still bears war's scars... Amid slow repairs, the Einst Series appear. That red one too...!?
To stop the plant planet nearing Earth, the Colony Laser is the only way! Londo Bell heads for Gryps II.
Heading to meet Beauty, who's bringing supplies from the moon...
Gryps II failed. We must storm the plant planet and destroy it within! Space Tremor's final battle begins.
The plant planet Dirad nears Earth. To stop the rooting, destroy it within! The Dragon follows Londo Bell in.
Burning's unit heads from north Dirad to the core... Resistance is fierce.
From south Dirad, Banjo's group heads for the core. That man awaits...
The Nadesico reaches Dirad's core... Can it stop Dirad taking root?
Aura Battlers surface, sowing chaos. Via Dr. Tarsan's Warp Beam, Hazuki's group drops to Nergal's Sasebo Dock.
Back at the Saotome Lab to test a new Getter reactor, the team finds...
Not only Sheela but Elle's Goraon has been located. However, it's...
Dangel and Warukimedes wait at Demon Mask Castle. Unbowed by threats, Combattler V went first...
The Nadesico's computer Omoikane has run amok. To fix it, Kyosuke's group dives into virtual reality.
Brought up by someone, Drake now seeks to rule the surface world too.
Trouble strikes the Far East Branch. What's happened at the base...?
The Mykene base is found. Tetsuya and Jun left alone for Bardos Island. Just the two of them is too risky...
Akira's mother Reiko seeks Mutron's power at the Mutron ruins. Find her before the Demon Empire does...
Failing to take the Star of La Mu, the Demon Empire rams in with Demon Island itself. The final battle begins...
Sensing Meganoids, the Elshank came to Mars's mountains. There...
To end the cornered Hazard Pasha's scheme, Team Tobikage returns to the Mars Frontier Base...
The Nadesico waited in Mars space to meet the Elshank, but...
The Zambot Team launched after the fleeing Gaizok battleship Bandock. The Elshank and Nadesico follow.
The Weissritter turns grotesque. Kyosuke feels Excellen's heartbeat...
An energy reading appears at Texas Colony, which should be in ruins.
The Devil Gundam, thought dead, appears near Neo Japan Colony...
Vega was busy near the moon: it was building Skull Moon Base there.
DG Cells made Neo Japan Colony the Devil Colony, its tentacles reaching Earth. Stop its core, or Earth is next!
Neo Zeon lay quiet, but in secret it was plotting to drop Fifth Luna...
The Stone Circle glows eerily... Kyosuke and Excellen feel something.
Campbell's envoy Deus says Empress Janera is in the Green Oasis area...
Chasing Gardy, Rom's group storms the Gyandlar Fortress. The final battle with the syndicate begins.
To save Major Shiratori, bridge to Jovian-Earth peace, Londo Bell rushes to the Meganoid base, but...
The "Calculation Unit," left by ancient Martians. A new war erupts over it...
Her memory regained, Pai was headed home to the Bunker flagship... What will become of the Dangaioh Team!?
The Elshank's wormhole drive and the Nadesico's Boson Jump take both ships to Muge Zorbados's red space...
Muge's universe, now become Einst space... What awaits beyond...? The battle for the galaxy begins.
Bearing all sins, Axis heads for Earth. What answer did our ex-ally find...
Londo Bell has split Axis. But it wasn't all over...
Got: Full Armor Hyaku Shiki Kai
